review.images: Seven villa-specific renders from Property Shop Investment’s public Yas Riva gallery, matched to the villa development and public Aldar factsheet.
review.location: Phase-specific schematic map linked publicly by Yas Island Villas and hosted by UAE Projects. Property Finder’s URL contains the word residences, but the record used here is explicitly the Yas Riva villa record and its 4–6-bedroom unit sheets. Airport estimates conflict across sources and were omitted.
review.floorPlans: Eight complete original published plan images, each checked against its scheme, floors and printed average area. The public factsheet is linked separately. Internal briefing and confidential plan PDF were excluded from the page assets.

unavailable: Separate verified side-canal drawing, surveyed villa access point and exact signed areas.
